policy.assumption_01: 1H first raw 3m source wick represents PHYSICAL contact only, not author first valid POI test.
policy.assumption_02: A solitary physical episode may be prioritized for source review; never sufficient for owner-valid test.
policy.assumption_03: Source 15m IMB/SNR price geometry is not enough to choose Trigger vs direct VC.
policy.assumption_04: Subsequent original 5m aligned price pattern is not sufficient to confirm owner 5m VC.
policy.assumption_05: 4H C46 source parent index is not proof of author-valid parent test/raid.
policy.assumption_06: Source RB proxy requires independently authenticated wick raid or IMB interaction and 2-candle validity to become author RB.
policy.assumption_07: 4H IMB nesting veto and only IMB/SNR entry VC remain author text requirements but parent type and valid VC unproven.
policy.assumption_08: Any source candidate is research-review-only; no Entry, SL, TP, order, fill, trade, statistical edge or numeric profit.
